name: halliday-sfl-analysis-skill
description: Hallidayan SFL, Chinese SFL, and grammatical-metaphor identification with retained-source integrity and source-verified citations.

interface.shortDescription: Hallidayan and Chinese SFL analysis with verified source tracing.
interface.longDescription: Analyze English and Chinese texts through field, tenor, mode, ideational, interpersonal, and textual meaning; identify grammatical metaphor with language-internal congruent agnates, evidence, counter-tests, and confidence; preserve private PDF/PPTX/EPUB evidence with integrity metadata; and support theoretical claims with complete source identities and verified page, slide, or EPUB section citations.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this text with Hallidayan SFL at full depth and cite page-verified primary sources.
Compare the metafunctional choices in these two passages.
Unpack the grammatical metaphors in this academic text.
Analyze this Chinese clause with the Chinese SFL framework and give a natural Chinese congruent form.
Decide whether this clause or word contains grammatical metaphor, give the congruent form and identification evidence, and cite exact source pages.
